verdict.rationale: Bento's docs mention creating broadcasts via its CLI and MCP surfaces (bento-docs-16, bento-docs-17, bento-docs-18), and the REST API is documented for events, subscribers, and transactional email (bento-docs-1, bento-docs-3), but no explicit documented REST endpoint for creating/scheduling a broadcast/campaign is shown, and probes found no OpenAPI spec (bento-probe-3). missing for 10: explicit public REST API endpoint/schema for broadcast creation and scheduling, independent confirmation that scheduling works end-to-end without dashboard interaction.
